title: A double-blinded, randomized, placebo-controlled, multi-center trial of Efgartigimod in autoimmune dementia (EfgaDem)
official: A double-blinded, randomized, placebo-controlled, multi-center trial of Efgartigimod in autoimmune dementia (EfgaDem)
summary: Main objective: To investigate the efficacy of 52 weeks treatment with the FcRn inhibitor Efgartigimod in comparison to placebo regarding the cognitive impairment in patients with autoimmune dementia.

interventions.name: Injection solution according to Vyvgart 1000 mg solution for injection in pre-filled syriges without active substance efgartigimod alfa.
Vyvgart 1 000 mg solution for injection in pre-filled syringe

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Male and female subjects ≥ 40 years of age
2. Expert diagnosis of progressive cognitive impairment or dementia for more than 3 months
3. 10 < MoCA ≤ 25
4. Presence of anti-brain autoantibodies in serum and/or CSF
5. Age ≥ 40 years
6. Speaks German at a level that, as determined by the investigator, allows to understand the patient information and to reliably perform the neuropsychological assessments
7. Written consent to participate in the study
8. The patient is capable to attend study visits
9. Vaccination according to STIKO recommendations (incl. COVID-19 vaccination)
Exclusion criteria:
1. Dysfunction (other than neurodegenerative or immunological) that could distort or obscure the diagnosis of dementia such as vitamin deficiency or hypothyroidism
2. HIV infection
3. Active, severe infections (e.g. sepsis and opportunistic infections)
4. History of chronically active hepatitis including active or chronic hepatitis B, acute or chronic hepatitis C
5. Clinically significant infection involving intravenous administration of antibiotics and hospitalization in the 4 weeks prior to the screening visit
6. Serious impairment of the immune system
7. Severe disease in the renal, cardiovascular or hematological system
8. Any medical condition that, in the opinion of the Investigator, might interfere with the patient’s participation in the trial or poses any added risk for the patient
9. Severe active psychiatric illness
10. Contraindications against MRI examination (e.g. wearers of pacemakers, deep brain stimulators, cerebrospinal fluid shunt valves, very large tattoos, metal splinter injuries and implants containing metal in the body)
11. Participation in any other investigational drug study or exposure to an investigational drug within 5 half-lives of the study drug at baseline
12. MRI findings (macro bleeding, malignant tumors)
13. Treatment with B-cell depleting therapy in the last 6 months
14. History of recurrent or chronic infections or with underlying diseases which may further predispose patients to serious infection
15. Sexually active male and female patients of reproductive potential (female patients/female partners of patients less than 12 months postmenopausal) who do not use highly effective contraception methods (pearl index <1) during treatment
16. Hypersensitivity to the active substance and/or pharmaceutical excipients
17. Known cytokine release syndrome after infusions
18. Pregnancy or lactation
